claims.text: The resort is steps from the sand, historic Highway 101 and the coastal town of Encinitas, and blends into the bluffs in an eco design.

findings.quote: Steps from sunlit sand, historic Highway 101 and the coastal town of Encinitas, Alila Marea Beach Resort blends seamlessly into the bluffs in an innovative expression of eco design.
findings.note: The page states every element of the claim.

claims.text: The resort is designed to echo the surrounding coastal bluff, beach and ocean, framed by natural stone, warm woods and clean lines.

findings.quote: Designed to emulate the surrounding coastal bluff, beach and ocean, the resort is framed by natural stone, warm woods and clean lines
findings.note: The page states the design inspiration and the materials named in the claim.

claims.text: Nearly every room has coastal views.

findings.quote: Alila Marea combines understated elegance with coastal views from nearly every room.
findings.note: The page directly states nearly every room has coastal views.

findings.quote: Nearly every guestroom offers breathtaking coastal views
findings.note: The rooms page confirms the same point.

claims.text: Occupancy is limited to two people per room to keep the atmosphere tranquil.

findings.quote: We maintain an atmosphere of tranquility with a maximum occupancy of two people per room to ensure the comfort of all guests.
findings.note: The page states the two-person limit and links it to tranquility.

claims.text: Some rooms have an oversized patio with a private firepit and seating.

findings.quote: an oversized 295-311-square-foot patio with a private firepit and cozy seating for you and your guests
findings.note: The One King Bed Coastline View with Firepit room has this patio.

claims.text: Each room has a rack for hanging wetsuits.

findings.quote: Guests who enjoy getting wet can hang their wetsuits on the convenient racks in each room.
findings.note: The review states every room has a wetsuit rack.

claims.text: Spa Alila treatments use minerals and botanicals sourced from the natural landscape.

findings.quote: offering treatments with thoughtfully sourced minerals and botanicals from the natural landscape
findings.note: The page directly describes the sourcing of Spa Alila treatments.

claims.text: Seaside Intention Yoga leads guests through mindful movement and an intention-setting exercise using cobblestones on Ponto Beach.

findings.quote: Our instructors will lead you through mindful movement and an intention-setting exercise using cobblestones on Ponto Beach.
findings.note: The page describes Seaside Intention Yoga exactly as claimed.

claims.text: Guests can explore Leucadia, Encinitas, Carlsbad and Cardiff-by-the-Sea on electric-assist bikes.

findings.quote: Take an electric-assist bike for a spin along the coast for an environmentally friendly way to explore Leucadia, Encinitas, Carlsbad and Cardiff-by-the-Sea
findings.note: The page names all four places.

claims.text: Part of the cost of The Endless Wave surf experience supports the Rob Machado Foundation, which promotes clean oceans and drinking water.

findings.quote: A portion of the cost supports the Rob Machado Foundation, which promotes clean oceans and drinking water.
findings.note: This appears in The Endless Wave details.

findings.quote: A portion of the cost of your experience will support the Rob Machado Foundation, dedicated to promoting clean oceans and safe drinking water.
findings.note: The Alila Moments page confirms the same point.

claims.text: Solar power preheats the pool and water.

findings.quote: Our green initiatives include solar power for all pool and water preheating
findings.note: The page directly states solar preheating of the pool and water.

claims.text: VAGA Restaurant & Bar serves coastal cuisine with sweeping ocean views.

findings.quote: Savor coastal cuisine at VAGA Restaurant & Bar at Alila Marea Beach Resort Encinitas, where locally inspired flavors meet sweeping ocean views.
findings.note: The page states both the coastal cuisine and the sweeping ocean views.

claims.text: South Ponto State Beach is steps from the resort, and a Beach Concierge provides beach chairs, beach games and surfboards.

findings.quote: South Ponto State Beach, just steps from Alila Marea. Our Beach Concierge is at your service with beach chairs, beach games, surf boards and more.
findings.note: The page covers the beach's proximity and all three items the concierge provides.

claims.text: The Endless Wave surf experience offers expert instructors, demo boards and hidden breaks.

findings.quote: Expert instructors, demo boards, legendary waters and hidden breaks await as you dive into surf culture
findings.note: The page names all three elements.

claims.text: Spa Alila offers wellness experiences including breathwork, astrology consultations and sound healing sessions.

findings.quote: Delve into transformative wellness experiences that go beyond the physical, including breathwork, astrology consultations and sound healing sessions.
findings.note: The page lists all three experiences.

claims.text: The Grandview Suite has picture windows overlooking Batiquitos Lagoon, floor-to-ceiling windows facing the Pacific, and a double-sided fireplace opening to a patio.

findings.quote: with three large picture windows overlooking Batiquitos Lagoon and west-facing floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing Pacific Ocean views. The double-sided fireplace opens up to an outdoor living space on the patio
findings.note: This is from the Grandview Suite description and covers all three features.

claims.text: Large-scale works by artist in residence Aaron Chang hang in the resort, and surfboard wall panels by local board shaper Brian Szymanski decorate The Pocket.

findings.quote: Large-scale pieces by our artist in residence, Aaron Chang, inspire contemplation, while surfboard wall panels by local board shaper Brian Szymanski infuse The Pocket with beachside energy.
findings.note: The page states both the artworks and where they are, described as within our walls.

claims.text: The resort is tailored for adults and caters to adults and couples more than younger generations.

findings.quote: Tailored for adults seeking a refined coastal escape
findings.note: The official page says the resort is tailored for adults.

findings.quote: Alila Marea caters to high net worth adults and couples more than Gen Z or Alpha.
findings.note: The review covers the adults-and-couples-over-younger-generations element.

claims.text: The local stretch of Pacific beach can be rockier than others, so a chair is more useful than a towel.

findings.quote: this stretch of Pacific beaches can be a little rockier than others, so bring a chair rather than a towel if you can.
findings.note: The review makes the same point as the claim.

claims.text: The hotel does not offer self-parking.

findings.quote: Please note the hotel does not offer self-parking.
findings.note: The page states this directly.
